activationRule: An import is a future course dependency, not a delivered outcome. Activate only after the corresponding deep chapter and assessment exist; qualified readers may demonstrate equivalent knowledge. No Book II-to-Book I dependency.

chapters.title: Computing with DNA
chapters.exitCheck: Verify a nontrivial directed path and identify a filter-surviving invalid candidate.

chapters.exitCheck: Reconstruct each operation from the primary paper; simulate filter losses and missing witnesses.
